splits.tie_policy: Equal timestamps stay in one split; ratios may differ slightly from 80/10/10.

source.release: Amazon Reviews 2023, official deduplicated 5-core IDs before splitting
source.normalization: Rename parent_asin to item_id; no rating filter, no extra k-core or user holdout; preserve all supplied timestamps.
source.deviation: User-selected Musical Instruments 2023 5-core, global timestamp 80/10/10; not a paper Table1 category reproduction.

history: Every event sees only earlier events in timestamp,row-index order; no per-user split.
i2i: Only events in splits.train enter unordered co-occurrence.
